name: Elicit
description: AI research assistant that searches academic papers, helps screen abstracts against criteria, and extracts structured findings into review tables.

name: Consensus
description: AI search engine over scientific literature that returns quick summaries of what studies conclude and cites the underlying papers for each claim.

name: Undermind
description: AI research search service that runs deep iterative literature searches on a research question and produces a cited report of key papers and findings.

name: ScienceOpen
description: Discovery platform combining a large indexed article database with researcher networking, contextual reviews, and curated collections.

name: Retraction Watch Database
description: Searchable database of retractions, corrections, and expressions of concern across scholarly journals, maintained by the Retraction Watch team with Crossref.

name: PubPeer
description: Online forum for post-publication peer review where users comment on published papers and potential problems, indexed by DOI and searchable.

name: VOSviewer
description: Free software for constructing and visualizing bibliometric maps of publications, authors, keywords, and citation networks.

name: JabRef
description: Open-source bibliography reference manager built around BibTeX and BibLaTeX files, with search, grouping, and integration with LaTeX editors.

name: Hypothesis
description: Open web annotation service for publicly annotating and discussing web pages and PDFs, with groups for collaborative reading and an API.

name: Tropy
description: Desktop application for organizing and annotating research photographs from archives, with metadata templates and export to other tools.

name: Google Trends
description: Public tool showing relative search interest over time and by region for queries and topics, with yearly and trending data explorations.

name: Perplexity
description: AI answer engine that responds to questions with synthesized summaries and inline citations, offering focused research modes and an API.

name: DuckDuckGo
description: Privacy-focused web search engine that does not track users, with instant answers, bang shortcuts to site-specific search, and no ad profiling.

name: Obsidian
description: Local-first markdown knowledge base linking notes in a graph, with plugins, backlinks, and support for long-form research writing.

name: Logseq
description: Open-source outliner for linked notes in markdown and org-mode with block references, queries, and local file storage.

name: wallabag
description: Open-source read-it-later application that saves articles for offline reading, strips clutter, and can self-host with a REST API.

name: ZoteroBib
description: Free web citation generator from the Zotero team that builds bibliographies in many styles from DOIs, URLs, ISBNs, and titles without an account.

name: Publish or Perish
description: Desktop and online application by Anne-Wil Harzing that analyzes citation data from Google Scholar and other sources for author and journal metrics.

name: Memento Time Travel
description: Memento framework service that forwards any web page URL to the closest archived snapshot across participating web archives.

name: archive.today
description: Snapshot service that captures on-demand permanent copies of web pages, preserving page content as rendered at capture time.
best_for: Citing pages that change or vanish

name: Webrecorder
description: Open-source project and service suite for high-fidelity web archiving, including Browsertrix crawling and ReplayWeb.page replay tools.

name: ReplayWeb.page
description: Browser-based viewer that replays WARC and WACZ web archive files locally with faithful page rendering, without a server.

name: Kiwix
description: Offline reader and library for ZIM archives of websites such as Wikipedia, letting users store and browse full site copies without internet access.

name: ArchiveBox
description: Self-hosted archiving tool that snapshots URLs into HTML, PDF, screenshot, and WARC formats, indexed in a searchable local interface.

name: HTTrack
description: Free website copier that downloads sites to a local directory with link structure preserved for offline browsing and archival.

name: NDL WARP
description: Web Archiving Project of the National Diet Library of Japan, collecting and preserving Japanese websites and making archived pages browsable.

name: PANDORA
description: PANDORA web archive of the National Library of Australia, preserving selected Australian online publications and significant websites.

name: Netarkivet
description: Danish national web archive operated by the Royal Danish Library, harvesting Danish websites since 2005 with search tools for researchers.

name: Vefsafn
description: Icelandic web archive run by the National and University Library of Iceland, collecting Icelandic websites for long-term preservation and access.
publisher: National and University Library of Iceland

name: International Internet Preservation Consortium
description: Consortium of libraries and archives coordinating web archiving practice, tools, and standards, with member resources and conference materials.

name: oldweb.today
description: Emulation service that lets users browse archived websites in historically accurate vintage browsers within a web page.
best_for: Browsing old sites as they appeared

name: Archive Team
description: Volunteer collective that rescues and mirrors endangered websites and digital content, documenting its work and tools on a public wiki.

name: WebArchiv
description: Czech web archive of the National Library of the Czech Republic, harvesting and preserving Czech online content for research access.
publisher: National Library of the Czech Republic

name: Welsh Newspapers Online
description: Free searchable archive of digitized Welsh newspapers and periodicals from 1804 to 1919 provided by the National Library of Wales.

name: California Digital Newspaper Collection
description: Digitized collection of historical California newspapers from 1846 onward, offering full-text search and page images through UC Riverside.

name: Google News Archive
description: Google's browsable index of scanned historical newspapers, with full-text search across digitized titles from many countries.

name: Newspapers.com
description: Large commercial archive of digitized US and international newspapers with full-text search, clipping tools, and subscription access beyond free pages.
access_requirements: Some pages free; full access requires a subscription

name: NYS Historic Newspapers
description: Free archive of digitized New York State newspapers provided by the New York State Library and partner institutions, with full-text search.

name: The Portal to Texas History
description: Digital collections of Texas history from the University of North Texas Libraries, including the Texas Digital Newspaper Program with searchable page images.

name: Colorado Historic Newspapers Collection
description: Free collection of digitized Colorado newspapers from 1859 onward, with keyword search and page images maintained by the Colorado State Library.

name: ANNO Austrian Newspapers Online
description: Austrian Newspapers Online from the Austrian National Library, a digitized archive of historic Austrian press titles with full-text search and page images.

name: e-newspaperarchives.ch
description: Swiss digitized newspaper and journal archive maintained by the Swiss National Library, with French and German interface options and full-text search.

name: RetroNews
description: Press archive of the National Library of France with digitized French newspapers and periodicals spanning several centuries, free plus premium tiers.

name: Utah Digital Newspapers
description: Digitized historic Utah newspapers with full-text search, built by the University of Utah Marriott Library and partner institutions.

name: Illinois Digital Newspaper Collections
description: Free digitized Illinois newspaper collections from the University of Illinois Library, with full-text search across historic state titles.

name: Hoosier State Chronicles
description: Program of the Indiana State Library digitizing historic Indiana newspapers, with free full-text search and downloadable page images.

name: Hemeroteca Digital
description: Digital press library of the National Library of Spain with digitized Spanish newspapers, magazines, and illustrated periodicals for free online reading.

name: New York Times Article Archive
description: The New York Times own article archive covering 1851 to the present, with searchable article pages and paid access to full historical articles.
access_requirements: Search free; full articles may require purchase or subscription

name: D3.js
description: JavaScript library for building custom data visualizations in the browser by binding data to the document object model with web standards.

name: Plotly
description: Graphing libraries and chart studio for interactive charts in Python, R, and JavaScript, widely used for publication-ready web figures.

name: Apache ECharts
description: Open-source JavaScript charting library from the Apache Software Foundation supporting line, bar, map, and custom visualizations at scale.

name: Scrapy
description: Python framework for crawling websites and extracting structured data, with pipelines for cleaning, exporting, and scheduling collection runs.

name: The Pudding
description: Digital publication producing visual essays that combine journalism, data analysis, and web design to explain cultural and social topics.

name: Gapminder
description: Independent foundation promoting a fact-based worldview with free teaching materials, datasets on global development, and visualization tools.

name: FlowingData
description: Blog by Nathan Yau on visualization, statistics, and design, featuring charts of real datasets and practical tutorials for data graphics.

name: Information is Beautiful
description: Studio and site by David McCandless publishing data visualizations and infographics that explore ideas, issues, and datasets in the news.

name: Knight Center for Journalism in the Americas
description: Program at the University of Texas at Austin training journalists across the Americas, best known for free online data journalism courses.

name: European Journalism Centre
description: Independent nonprofit institute supporting journalism through grants, training, and programs for newsrooms across Europe and beyond.

name: Data Journalism.com
description: European Journalism Centre platform hosting the Data Journalism Handbook editions, expert lectures, courses, and a handbook library for journalists.

name: Leaflet
description: Lightweight open-source JavaScript library for interactive maps, widely used in newsrooms for embedding map-based data stories.

name: Data Visualisation Catalogue
description: Reference guide to chart and visualization types, describing the purpose, anatomy, and suitable use cases of dozens of formats.

name: Investigative Reporters and Editors
description: Membership organization for investigative and data journalists, running NICAR conferences, training, and a library of datasets and tipsheets.

name: ColorBrewer
description: Color advice tool by Cynthia Brewer for selecting color schemes for maps and charts, with colorblind-safe and print-friendly palettes.

name: UniProt
description: Comprehensive protein sequence and functional information database with cross-references, search, and programmatic REST API access.

name: Ensembl
description: Genome browser and comparative genomics database for vertebrates and other species, with REST and gRPC interfaces for programmatic access.

name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
description: Archive of experimentally determined 3D structures of proteins, nucleic acids, and complexes, with search tools and a data API.

name: Open Targets
description: Platform integrating genetics, genomics, and drug data to score target-disease associations for therapeutic research, with a GraphQL API.

name: Overpass API
description: Read-only API serving custom queries over OpenStreetMap data, returning map elements matching user-defined filters.

name: DBpedia
description: Knowledge graph extracted from Wikipedia structured content, with SPARQL endpoint, lookup services, and language chapter editions.

name: CoinGecko
description: Cryptocurrency data platform providing prices, market capitalization, trading volume, and exchange data with a public REST API.

name: The Space Devs
description: Community team maintaining Launch Library 2, a REST API for launch schedules, spacecraft events, and astronaut data.
access_requirements: Free tier open; registration raises rate limits

name: OpenSanctions
description: Database merging sanctions lists, politically exposed person data, and watchlists into searchable entities with an API and bulk downloads.
access_requirements: Free for non-commercial use; commercial licensing available

name: Stack Exchange API
description: REST API for questions, answers, users, and tags across Stack Exchange network sites including Stack Overflow, with filterable responses.

name: MET Norway Weather API
description: Free weather forecast API from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute delivering location forecasts worldwide with attribution requirements.
access_requirements: User identification header and attribution required

name: Smithsonian Open Access
description: Program releasing millions of Smithsonian collection images and metadata under CC0, with a public API for search and data retrieval.

name: Rijksmuseum API
description: Interface to the Rijksmuseum collection providing object metadata and high-resolution images of Dutch art and history for reuse.

name: The Met Collection API
description: Public API for The Metropolitan Museum of Art collection, returning object records and open-access images for art research.

name: Harvard Art Museums Collections
description: Online collections of the Harvard Art Museums with object records and images, offered under open access with a documented public API.

name: Openverse
description: Search engine for openly licensed images and audio across many sources, with an API for embedding open content searches.

name: Nager.Date
description: Free public API for worldwide public holidays, providing country holiday lists, long weekends, and upcoming holiday lookups.

name: REST Countries
description: Free API returning country reference data including names, capitals, currencies, languages, flags, and geographic coordinates.

name: Open Notify
description: Simple open API providing live International Space Station location and current astronauts in space as plain data endpoints.

name: Sunrise-Sunset
description: Free API returning sunrise, sunset, and twilight times for any latitude and longitude on a chosen date.

name: OpenSky Network
description: Community-run network of ADS-B receivers offering live and historical air traffic data through a free research API.
access_requirements: Anonymous access limited; free account for higher limits

name: EUvsDisinfo
description: EU project identifying, analyzing, and debunking disinformation narratives targeting the European Union, with a searchable database of cases.

name: Dubawa
description: West African verification initiative fact-checking public claims and training journalists across Nigeria, Ghana, Sierra Leone, and Liberia.

name: Pagella Politica
description: Italian fact-checking outlet rating statements by politicians and public figures on a five-point scale from true to false.

name: Newtral
description: Spanish media company and verified fact-checking organization examining claims by politicians and viral content, alongside original reporting.

name: Demagog
description: Polish fact-checking organization analyzing statements by politicians and public figures, publishing verdicts and debate analyses.

name: Maldita.es
description: Spanish nonprofit journalism organization specializing in fact-checking of politics, social media misinformation, and science claims.

name: Faktisk.no
description: Norwegian collaborative fact-checking service run by major media houses, rating claims from politics and public debate.

name: Aos Fatos
description: Brazilian fact-checking and data journalism newsroom verifying political statements and viral content, with transparency ratings.

name: ColombiaCheck
description: Colombian fact-checking platform verifying statements by public figures and information circulating during elections and crises.

name: DFRLab
description: Digital Forensic Research Lab of the Atlantic Council researching influence operations and disinformation, publishing open-source investigations.

name: Climate Feedback
description: Network of scientists reviewing and rating the accuracy of climate-related media coverage, publishing credibility evaluations of claims and sources.

name: Health Feedback
description: Network of scientists reviewing the scientific accuracy of health and biomedical news articles and rating their credibility.

name: Alt News
description: Indian fact-checking website investigating misinformation, viral claims, and political statements in English and Hindi.

name: PesaCheck
description: Fact-checking initiative of Code for Africa verifying financial, statistical, and political claims across East African countries.

name: Media Bias/Fact Check
description: Independent site rating the bias and factual reporting of thousands of news sources with a searchable database and methodology notes.

name: Rappler Fact Check
description: Fact-checking section of the Philippine news organization Rappler, verifying claims of politicians and viral social media content.
